hero.title: Enough volunteers for every shift.
hero.titleHighlight: Without the Excel and WhatsApp chaos.
hero.intro: Free volunteer scheduling for {target}: create shifts online, share the link to the volunteer list and volunteers sign themselves up in seconds. The organising committee sees every assignment live. Anyone can sign up, including parents, alumni and people from friendly clubs – no account and no tedious spreadsheets.
hero.protectedText: To protect volunteer data from unauthorised access, shift plans are not listed publicly. You get the link to your event directly from your leadership team by email or WhatsApp.

associations.title: With Cevi, Scouts or Jubla? There are dedicated versions.
associations.text: Leaders log in there directly with their association account; department or group and leadership rights are applied automatically. Same features, also free.

steps.title: A full volunteer list in three steps.
steps.createText: The committee sets up shifts: when, what needs doing and how many people are needed. With last year’s template it takes minutes.
steps.shareText: {org, select, other {Send the link via WhatsApp, email or flyer. You decide who may sign up: everyone, only your {unit} or individual age groups.}}
steps.signupText: Volunteers pick their own shift, including parents and alumni {org, select, verein {without an account} other {without {authShort}}}. The committee instantly sees where gaps remain.

comparison.title: Why not just Excel or WhatsApp?
comparison.intro: Almost every festival committee and leadership team starts with a shared spreadsheet or a group chat – and quickly hits the same frustrations. Here is the difference at a glance.

noPassword.title: Sign up without password or app
noPassword.desc: Volunteers simply click the link and sign up.

minAge.title: Automatic minimum age check
minAge.desc: Shifts with an age limit (e.g. bar from 16 or 18).

calendar.title: Calendar sync & reminders
calendar.desc: The shift right in your phone calendar.
calendar.chat: Gets lost in the chat history

overview.title: Live overview for the committee
overview.desc: See instantly which shifts are still open.

template.title: Template for next year
template.desc: Easily reuse camp and festival shifts.

privacy.title: Data protection under Swiss FADP
privacy.desc: Phone numbers and emails only visible to the committee.
privacy.chat: Data public in the group chat

vouchers.title: Digital meal vouchers
vouchers.desc: Scan the QR code for volunteer meals at the stand.

benefits.title: {org, select, verein {Volunteer scheduling, built for everyday club life.} other {Volunteer scheduling, built for everyday {orgName} life.}}
benefits.text: {org, select, other {Whether you’re at the grill, organising the event or leading the whole {unit} – the shift plan takes the tedious organising off your hands, from the village fair to summer camp.}}
benefits.helpersText: Pick a shift right in the chat browser. No new password and an automatic calendar reminder before the shift.
benefits.committeeText: Live overview of all shifts, automatic age check (e.g. bar from 18) and last year’s templates in one click.
benefits.leadText: {org, select, other {A fixed subdomain with your {unit}’s logo and colour. Leadership rights are taken directly from {authShort}.}}

features.loginTitle: Log in without a new password
features.loginText: Leaders log in with their usual {authShort} account – name, {unit} and age groups are there instantly. Parents, alumni and volunteers simply sign up with their {nickname} and date of birth.
features.loginOnce: Log in once, you’re in everywhere
features.addressText: {org, select, other {Your {unit} gets a fixed web address with logo and colour. Share it once and every event is there, year after year.}}
features.eventsText: Plan the village fair, Whitsun camp, summer camp or anniversary at the same time. Each committee has access to its own event, and next year you start from today’s template.
features.eventsScope: Each committee sees its own area
features.mobileText: Signing up takes seconds, straight from the chat. And the committee can still assign someone quickly in the festival tent or at the grill. On iPhone and Android, no installation.

final.title: No more spreadsheet chaos and empty shifts.
final.text: Village fair, summer camp or anniversary: get started now with {name}. The help centre answers questions about use and setup step by step.
final.note: An independent, volunteer-run project · Free for all {target}.
